DESCRIPTION:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CUS-03
**Title:** Submit Request form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Contact Us
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Contact Us page, fill a valid name and an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, leave email and message empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real mobile-format, email-required and message-required validation messages are displayed, and no enquiry is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Contact Us page
2. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
3. Leave email and message empty
4. Click Submit Request
5. Verify the mobile-format and other validation messages are shown
NAME: TC-CUS-03: Submit Request form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Contact Us

DESCRIPTION:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CUS-01
**Title:** Submit Request enquiry submits successfully on Contact Us
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Contact Us page, fill name, mobile, email and message, and click Submit Request.

**Expected Result:**
The user sees the thank-you message: "Thank you for contacting us, Our executive will call you soon!!".

**Steps:**
1. Open the Contact Us page
2. Fill name, mobile, email and message
3. Click Submit Request
4. Verify the thank-you confirmation message is shown
